exact_statement: Retains the v7 positive-R transport theorem unchanged. Let g be +1 exactly on {0,1,2} in the three-bit cube, gprime its vertex4 flip, and w=(g,gprime) with physical selector s. For every integer N>=1 let h_N=-1 exactly when a disjoint three-bit controller is in {0,1,2} and a disjoint N-bit parity is -1, and let F_N=1-(1-w)(1-h_N)/2. The inner query is strictly K4-good, but the actual lifted query is strictly K4-bad, with E=B_s(F_N)-4Inf_s(F_N) in (1/128,1/120) independent of N. Its full odd-face cost q_s(F_N)=(3N+14)/128 exceeds the SAME Xi=5[r(1-r)I(w)+t(1-t)I(h)] physical drift by (33N+4)/2048 even with BOTH actual terminal Xi reserves retained. Thus q/E and q/R diverge, and coefficient-one full-q conversion is false; no v7 established theorem is refuted. H(F_N)=H(F_1)<=8 while I(F_N)=(27N+81)/128, so this is not an FEI counterfamily. For arbitrary disjoint Boolean children and any finite adaptive physical stopping tree, sum p(B_F-Kd_F)<=sum p rho(B_inner-Kd_inner)+Xi_root-E Xi_terminal, for every real K. Consequently the full entropy drop is at most (K+2/ln2) times spent influence plus Xi_root-E Xi_terminal plus the actual SIGNED inherited inner ledger. All full terminal H/I/Xi and independent old/reference/KL bills are retained; arbitrary-core inner source payment remains OPEN.
